A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RPG research framework. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices support reliable comparison; visually inspecting the plots resolved extraction problems, and relocated sections could be matched.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix G report original Qwen3-4B training results, AIME24/25 evaluations, and clipping, KL-coefficient and reference-update ablations.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix I retain original experiments and add benchmarks, 8K evaluations and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct results.

M1.justification: The KL objectives, surrogate losses, clipping rules and Algorithms 1–2 retain the same procedures. Normalized variants already existed in v2. Added pseudocode comments, the natural policy gradient connection and changing terminology from truncated to clipped do not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Evaluation expands from AIME24 and AIME25 to also include AMC23, MinervaMath and OlympiadBench, substantially broadening mathematical benchmark coverage. Training retains the 13.9k English subset of DAPO-Math-17k.

E2.justification: V3 Table 3 adds actual evaluations of REINFORCE++ and REINFORCE++-Baseline alongside the retained GRPO and DAPO comparisons. This substantially strengthens comparison with closely related REINFORCE methods; v2 only discussed REINFORCE++ in related work.

E3.justification: V3 adds 8K context experiments in Table 4, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct configurations in Table 8, and Pass@32 evaluation in Figure 7. V2 evaluated Qwen3-4B at 2K/4K using Mean@32. The retained experiments' stated 400-step training setup and default hyperparameters remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The clipping-ratio and KL/reference-update ablations are retained, with AMC23 evidence added to v3 Figures 8–9, corresponding to v2 Figures 6–7. Their original controls and AIME findings remain, so this is an extension of existing analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports independent training-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. Mean@32 was already labeled in v2's plots; its explanation in v3 and the added Pass@32 metric do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Matched 2K/4K AIME table entries are unchanged, but v3 adds extensive benchmark, comparator, 8K, Pass@32 and second-model results. New Table 4 reports AIME25 Best scores of 0.5208 for RPG-REINFORCE-URKL and 0.4740 for DAPO at 8K. Results are not uniformly favorable: REINFORCE++ leads OlympiadBench Best in Table 7.

T1.justification: New Appendix B derives a local natural policy gradient connection using a linear return approximation and quadratic KL approximation, yielding a Fisher-inverse update direction. This adds an auxiliary formal derivation; the original gradient propositions, surrogate equivalences and proofs remain unchanged after renumbering.

C1.justification: The core RPG contributions and claim of up to six percentage points over DAPO remain. The abstract and introduction add an 8K claim of 52% AIME25 accuracy versus 47% for official Qwen3-4B-Instruct. The PDFs do not establish matched evaluation settings for that official-model comparison.

C2.justification: V3 adds an explicit clipping bias–variance limitation and a natural policy gradient interpretation. Appendix I.2.1 changes the clipping explanation from decreasing to increasing entropy, consistent with the retained curves. However, a new Section 5 passage still attributes the benefit to reduced entropy, leaving conflicting interpretations.

D1.justification: V3 removes the four explicit AIME data-source URLs from the bibliography, reducing data-access guidance. The detailed experimental setup, hardware, optimizer, hyperparameters and project link otherwise remain unchanged; additional experiments receive little separate implementation documentation.

R1.justification: V3 adds citations and discussion connecting RPG to natural policy gradient and TRPO, plus references to Kool et al.'s baseline construction and Chu et al.'s GPG. Most research positioning remains intact in the relocated related-work section; the AIME source citations are removed.

P1.justification: Most prose and the scientific narrative remain intact. Related work moves from Section 6 to Appendix A, the Section 3 introduction is rewritten, terminology changes from truncated to clipped, and an ethics statement, affiliation and contact details are added.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn, existing experimental plots are reorganized into six-panel grids with AMC23, and Figure 3 gains comparator curves. V3 also adds separate 8K, Pass@32 and second-model figures, expands Table 3, and introduces Tables 4, 7 and 8. These substantially change the visual presentation beyond renumbering.

improvement.justification: Broader benchmarks, a second model and closer REINFORCE baselines improve the evidence beyond v2's narrow evaluation, including informative baseline wins in Table 7. The clipping-bias qualification also helps. These gains are tempered by v3 Table 4 reporting RPG-URKL AIME25 Last 0.5261 above Best 0.4938, conflicting entropy explanations, and unestablished comparability of the new 52%-versus-47% headline claim.
